name: Teal
shortDescription: Resume builder that tailors a resume to a job description. Free to try. Paid plans are on their site.
longDescription: Teal's homepage says you can create an ATS-friendly resume, tailor it with keywords from a job description, and track jobs saved from job boards with its Chrome extension. It also says you can create a free account. The page did not list a monthly plan price.
pricingNotes: The homepage says you can create a free account. It did not list a monthly plan price.
freeTierNotes: The homepage says you can create a free account. It did not spell out what stays free.
bestFor: Tailoring a resume to keywords in a job description
Tracking jobs saved from job boards
notIdealFor: Screening someone else's resume as a recruiter
strength: Teal's homepage says its AI tailors a resume to keywords in a job description and that you can create a free account.
weakness: The homepage did not list a monthly plan price.

useCaseFit.write-resume: Tailors a resume to keywords in a job description and tracks saved jobs.
